note: Based on the species-level description of Trinervitermes indicus in Chhotani (1997), original in English; the soldier is dimorphic and combined in one paragraph; alate and worker are not described; the upper limit of the ratio of nasus length to head length in the major soldier is damaged by OCR (given in the original as 0.45-p.54), so only its being about half the head length is recorded; synonymic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule brown, the region of the frontal gland slightly paler; nasus black; antennae brown, the apical segments slightly paler; dorsal abdomen pale brown, ventral surface straw-coloured; legs straw-coloured. Head and abdominal tergites with microscopic hairs, without long setae; sternites with short and long setae. Total body length 5.18–5.30 mm. Head, excluding the nasus, subpyriform to circular, slightly longer than wide without the nasus (length including nasus 2.45–2.50 mm, length excluding nasus 1.63–1.73 mm, width 1.53–1.65 mm); in profile considerably incurved behind the base of the nasus; occiput arched. Nasus conical, rather short (length 0.78–0.88 mm), about half the head length excluding the nasus. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3, segment 5 shorter than segment 4 and equal to segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, without a spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.28–0.30 mm, width 0.73–0.80 mm); anterior margin convex with a weak median impression; posterior margin convex. Minor soldier: head brown; nasus dark brown; abdominal tergites with microscopic hairs, without long setae; tip of the nasus with a few hairs; sternites with long and short setae. Total body length 3.50–4.35 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, slightly incurved anterolaterally behind the antennae; about one and a half times as long as wide (length including nasus 1.76–1.85 mm, length excluding nasus 1.10–1.13 mm, width 0.76–0.80 mm); in profile strongly incurved behind the base of the nasus, nasus swelling absent. Nasus long, cylindrical and narrow, shorter than the head length excluding the nasus; upturned at the tip (length 0.68–0.73 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.61–0.64). Antennae 12–13-segmented; segment 3 about 2 to 2.5 times segment 2; segment 4 shorter than segment 5. Mandibles as in the major soldier. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.23 mm, width 0.50 mm).
